item.title: American F-15 pilots shot down in Kuwait. How civilians helped downed US pilots
item.description: The Hidden Lightness with Jimmy Hinton – Three jets fell from the sky. What rose in their place was something far more powerful—a reminder that America’s presence in the world is not defined solely by critics or cable news narratives. Sometimes, it’s defined by strangers running toward danger, extending a hand, and saying, “You are safe.”
